capabilities: Highlight duplicate lines in the active note
Show a tooltip with the line number of the duplicate on hover
Display a notice when pasting lines that already exist in the file
extras: README lists possible future improvements, including detecting duplicate links, per-file/folder settings, cross-file detection, and a command to jump to the next duplicate.
motivation: The author often tracked items such as web links in notes and repeatedly added ones that were already present, so the plugin helps prevent this.
problem: Obsidian gives no indication that a line you are adding to a note already exists, so items like links get duplicated unnoticed.
summary: Highlights duplicate lines in the open note, shows where each line repeats, and warns when pasting lines that already exist.
